title: Exclusive report operation
responsibility: Runs an asynchronous report update under an exclusive lock file.

inputs.name: reportLock.directory
inputs.description: Directory path whose `.lock` child is opened with exclusive-create mode. It must permit creating and writing that lock file, which is closed and removed after the operation.

inputs.name: reportLock.operation
inputs.description: Asynchronous report work invoked after `.lock` is created and its PID is written. Its resolved value is returned, and its rejection propagates.

outputs.name: reportLock
outputs.description: Fulfills with the operation's resolved value after lock cleanup. The caller determines `T`; lock acquisition is attempted up to 200 times with 25-millisecond waits, and recovery removes a lock older than five seconds only when it contains a valid PID for a process that no longer exists.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with `Error('Report is busy; retry this update')` after all 200 lock attempts fail. Non-`EEXIST` open errors, lock write or close errors, final unlink errors other than `ENOENT`, and rejection reasons from `operation` propagate.
